li.p: Select SettingsVehicleLightsWelcome mirror/lightOn door unlock or On driver approach on the infotainment system screen. The door handle light will turn on for approximately 15 seconds.

section.title: Operating condition(s)
section.p: The lighting switch is turned on (AUTO position operates only at night), and all doors are closed and locked.

li.p: When On door unlock is selected:
Press the door unlock button on the smart key or digital key.
Touch the touch sensor on the front outside door handle while possessing the smart key or digital key.
When On driver approach is selected:
Approach the front outside door handle within 1 m (40 in) while possessing the smart key or digital key.
